mission: Next identity-capture batch runbook (owner ask 2026-10-19 00:33Z, item 3): the NEW100 plan is finished and enqueue-remaining-50 only replays it, so add the ops-write runbook enqueue-capture-batch. It plans the next batch live (uncaptured ambiguous Yuyu-Tei listings that the live resolver, F1 included, still finds ambiguous; oldest candidate first; default 50, at most 100) and enqueues it through the unchanged PR #116 tool. Each run waits for the owner in staging-ops; the dry run lists the exact batch and its storage fit and writes nothing; an apply needs the dry run's approved-list SHA-256. Staging only; PSA10 not read; no resolver, alias, collector, setting, price, Market Value/Index, secret or Railway change; no runbook run in this PR.

impacts.reason: New write runbook enqueue-capture-batch registered in RUNBOOKS as (write, collector-affecting). Planning is read-only (default_transaction_read_only session): one resolver run over the uncaptured ambiguous listings, then ops.replan's guards. Enqueue goes through scripts/yuyu_identity_capture_enqueue.py unchanged (all or nothing, every #116 guard), shared with enqueue-remaining-50 by moving its steps 2 to 4 into enqueue_list; enqueue-remaining-50's list and SHA are unchanged (batch label stays NEW<count>). Captures are claimed by ordinary scheduled Yuyu turns under the source budget; no source request, approval or mapping here.
Adds enqueue-capture-batch to the runbook choice and names its default in the count description. Jobs, environments, permissions, secrets and triggers unchanged.
Offline tests (shortlist order and drops, count limits, batch label in the pinned list, read-only candidate SQL, quiet windows) and runbook documentation.

dependencies: ops-write from PR #150; PR #116 enqueue tool (unchanged); ops.replan guards (unchanged); live resolver incl. D9 F1 (PR #171/#173, unchanged)
impact.deployment_impact: Runbook code and its workflow choice only. collector_services is empty and no raw_dependency_migration: 0 collector rollouts, no DDL. No path under services/, packages/ or apps/ changes. Merging writes nothing; each batch is a separate owner-approved run.

recovery.procedure: Native revert of this PR removes the runbook and its workflow choice. No data, schema, provider or service configuration to undo. Enqueued intents from a later apply are listed by work id in its summary and are never replayed.
recovery.trigger: A dry run that fails or selects a listing that is not an uncaptured, bounded ambiguous family.
recovery.backup: Not applicable for this PR: no schema or row change. Railway Postgres daily backups continue.
